hypothesis: The exact MU 15m breakout-pressure route may add a repeatable source-native edge after finite-depth fills, fees, funding, latency, stop behavior, and one-position-per-route lifecycle accounting.
decision: Keep MU report-only with no v53 live change. Exact audit-scoped 0xArchive marks resolve seven of nine processed portfolio episodes, but the apparent positive aggregate is entirely dependent on one large long winner. Stress PnL excluding that winner is -$101.41, both resolved shorts lose, and even the long slice becomes negative after largest-winner removal. Continue the frozen prospective and transport-parity collection; do not promote, resize, retune, or select a side from this sample.
falsifier: Reconsider only after a predeclared larger exact-source window has at least 20 independent onsets and 12 resolved lifecycle episodes, represents both sides, resolves material path gaps without synthetic prices, and remains positive under stress after removing the largest winner. Reject the candidate if the larger both-side sample remains non-positive or technically unresolved.

proposal_contract.recommendation: Keep MU report-only and preserve the frozen route while collecting exact prospective mark, depth, funding, both-side exits, and transport-parity evidence.
proposal_contract.why_now: Two additional eligible onsets supplied a second resolved short, while exact audit-scoped archive marks reduced technical censoring enough to expose the route's economic concentration.
proposal_contract.evidence_reviewed: The immutable 467-decision and 74139-book snapshot, 476182 exact websocket marks, 4199 audit-scoped exact 0xArchive marks, official funding, measured fee evidence, stress friction, and the unchanged frozen lifecycle contract.
proposal_contract.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Seven lifecycles resolve causally, but five lose, both shorts lose, and one large long winner contributes more than the entire aggregate profit.
proposal_contract.applicable_market_regime: Evidence remains concentrated in 15m breakouts with EMA9 versus EMA21 and depth-10 pressure; the current sample does not establish durable long or short regime edge.
proposal_contract.alternatives_considered: Immediate live addition, long-only post-hoc selection, parameter retuning, relaxed mark-gap standards, REST substitution, synthetic path repair, strict prospective-only accounting, and audit-scoped exact archive repair. Only continued frozen collection preserves an unbiased next test.
proposal_contract.expected_upside: A larger exact both-side sample can determine whether the route has repeatable positive expectancy without exposing v53 capital to an outlier-dependent candidate.
proposal_contract.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Largest-winner dependence, two losing shorts, remaining path censoring, unresolved transport parity, historical repairs not proving live capture uptime, fees and funding erasing small gross wins, and next-observed-depth exits differing from venue fills.
proposal_contract.validation_completed: Onset identity reconciled 14 of 14; archive marks were used only in audit-declared windows; one-position accounting, side attribution, fees, funding, residual latency, stress costs, signal exits, and stop exits were replayed from immutable inputs; every consumed file was rehashed.
proposal_contract.validation_still_required: The fixed 24-hour transport-parity window, at least 20 onsets and 12 resolved lifecycles, both-side representation beyond two short losses, exact live capture continuity, complete depth-sized entry and exit paths, and positive stress economics after largest-winner removal.
proposal_contract.success_metrics: At least 20 independent prospective onsets, at least 12 resolved lifecycle episodes with both sides represented, positive stress net and stress net excluding the largest winner, no synthetic path repair, and no unresolved source identity.
proposal_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Negative stress or ex-largest economics in the larger window, persistent material censoring, fee/funding drag exceeding gross edge, source/transport mismatch, or evidence-integrity failure.

limitations: Two of nine processed lifecycle episodes remain technically censored.
Both resolved short lifecycles lose; two observations do not establish a stable short distribution.
The positive aggregate and positive long result both become negative after removing the largest winner.
Historical exact archive marks repair risk-path evidence but do not prove prospective collector uptime.
The fixed transport-parity window remains incomplete and current transport blockers are unresolved.
Mark-triggered next-observed-depth exits are replay approximations rather than historical venue fills.
The stated sample sizes are investigation thresholds, not profitability or live-promotion gates.
No v53 strategy, asset, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, exit, execution, or deployment setting changed.
